data.body: Audit started after signed plan PASS and claim. Method defaults adopted from plan-review coaching: use calendar quarters for trends; present every period but mark n<10 as low-sample and avoid directional claims from those periods alone. Validation vocabulary is exactly: VALIDATED = direct evidence supports the bounded claim and no material confounder remains; QUALIFIED = evidence supports a narrower claim, relies on an explicit proxy, or retains a material confounder; REJECTED = evidence does not support the claim or an alternative explanation fully accounts for it. The independent reviewer must return one of these labels with a reason for every draft finding.
